description: Platform-governed trust metadata field registry, evidence access classes, and lineage bundle expectations for cross-domain data products.

evidence_access_classes.description: Evidence and trust metadata that may flow into customer-facing or advisor-facing product surfaces.
Evidence and trust metadata that exists for control, reconciliation, ingestion, or support workflows and should not be treated as a customer-facing product payload by default.

trust_metadata_fields.description: Published product identifier.
Published product contract version.
Tenant scope for the product payload.

How the tenant claim was established: caller_admitted (stated by the admitted caller), source_verified (proven against the owning source), or unattributed_caller (no tenant claim exists - tenant_id is then deliberately absent, never fabricated).
Portfolio-manager party scope whose effective-dated book membership is resolved by the product.
Booking-centre scope applied when resolving the product payload.
UTC timestamp when the product payload was generated.
Business-effective date carried by the product.
Timezone-aware timestamp generated by the source-owning producer for the current receipt or evidence envelope.
Source-owned business as-of date of the evidence represented by the current receipt or envelope.
Closed status indicating whether producer-owned temporal identity is available, missing, mixed, or not applicable to the current evidence scope.
Restatement or replay version that identifies regenerated product truth.

Published reconciliation posture for the product or its governing source inputs. reconciled is allowed only when an explicit policy proved it; unknown, partial, not_reconciled, and not_applicable are honest alternatives.
Bounded reason accompanying any non-reconciled reconciliation_status, naming why the posture holds (for example no_reconciliation_policy_established).
Published data-quality posture for the product or its governing source inputs.
Source-owned boolean indicating whether authoritative evidence is current for the requested product scope.
Source-owned freshness classification for the requested product scope.
Timestamp of the latest supportability or control evidence used by the product.
Fingerprint for the upstream source batch or event set.
Snapshot identifier for reproducible point-in-time source truth.
Deterministic cohort identifier for source-owned membership products.
Deterministic hash of the product payload or source-owned evidence snapshot.
Version of the governing policy or supportability rules applied to the payload.
Cross-service correlation identifier for tracing and support escalation.
Identifier for a downloadable or queryable lineage bundle.
Machine-readable explanation for a blocked or withheld product state.
Version of the audit-lineage metadata contract exposed to downstream consumers.
Fingerprint for the current product request or durable execution.
Ordered set of source services that materially contributed to the product.
Fingerprints for upstream requests used to derive the current product.
Metadata that explains how benchmark inputs were requested, resolved, or applied.
Metadata that explains how risk-free inputs were requested, resolved, or applied.
Coverage ratio or completeness fraction published for a governed result.
Coverage classification associated with a governed result.

lineage_bundle_classes.description: Lightweight lineage summary suitable for customer-facing or advisor-facing product support.
Operator-grade reconciliation evidence bundle for support, audit, and break investigation workflows.
Operator-grade data-quality coverage bundle for support and readiness workflows.
Operator-grade ingestion and replay evidence bundle for source troubleshooting.
